name: 2026 Standard Size Mah Jongg Cards, Four-Pack
whyWeLikeIt: The same official card in the standard size, which tucks neatly into a game bag. Four cards is one for each seat at the table.
whoItsFor: Hosts and players who prefer a card that fits into a travel set or a small bag.
limitations: The type is smaller than the large-print edition, and, like every League card, it is only good for the 2026 season. It does not include tiles.
descriptionOriginal: Four standard-size copies of the National Mah Jongg League's official 2026 hand card for American mahjong.
verificationSource: Cowork Amazon listing check, docs/commerce/buy-plan/PILOT-VERIFICATION-V2.csv in the earlier repository (decision keep; seller The National Mah Jongg League, Inc., ships from Amazon; in stock).
